statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-29070: smooth2() in src/cmsgamma.c of Little CMS 2.16, reached through the public cmsSmoothToneCurve() function, has no check on the table size or lambda it is given and can read past the end of a heap buffer (https://github.com/mm2/Little-CMS/issues/475). Upstream disputes the CVE because the function is never called in normal color management and exists only as a helper for low-level programming, but added a guard that makes smooth2() return failure when the table has fewer than four entries or lambda is close to zero: https://github.com/mm2/Little-CMS/commit/ec399d6879184e92a88c9099c60573f35e82e28b, first released in lcms2 2.18. Debian lists trixie's 2.16-2+deb13u2 as unfixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-29070). DHI publishes three rebuilds of Debian's lcms2 2.16-2+deb13u2 for Debian 13 (amd64 and arm64). Checked each one's liblcms2-2 and liblcms2-dev packages: the first rebuild's changelog records only a rebuild, while the second and third record the CVE-2025-29070 fix, and in both liblcms2.so.2 and the static liblcms2.a, cmsSmoothToneCurve() (into which smooth2() is inlined) is larger in the second and third rebuilds than in the first, on both architectures. The second rebuild, the first to carry the upstream commit, is the fixed version in this range; the first rebuild stays on the affected side.
